name: Mesh Production
author: PolyKit
description: Creates game-ready mesh derivatives such as collision geometry and level-of-detail assets.

zh-CN.name: 网格生产
zh-CN.description: 生成碰撞体和多级细节等可用于游戏引擎的网格派生资产。

en-US.name: Mesh Production
en-US.description: Creates game-ready mesh derivatives such as collision geometry and level-of-detail assets.

nodes.name: Collision Mesh
nodes.description: Builds a simplified collision proxy from the whole scene while preserving the source coordinate frame.

params_schema.label: Method
params_schema.tooltip: Convex Hull follows the outer silhouette; Bounding Box is the cheapest broad-phase proxy.

nodes.name: Generate LODs
nodes.description: Creates deterministic LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 GLB derivatives and a reduction report.

params_schema.label: LOD1 Ratio
params_schema.tooltip: Target triangle ratio for the first distant level.

params_schema.label: LOD2 Ratio
params_schema.tooltip: Target triangle ratio for the second distant level.

params_schema.label: Minimum Faces
params_schema.tooltip: Prevents a small component from collapsing below a usable triangle count.

nodes.name: Projection Bake
nodes.description: Projects a reference image into mesh UVs with a deterministic camera model and embedded GLB texture.

params_schema.label: Projection Mode
params_schema.tooltip: Camera-space UV projection used to place the embedded reference texture.

params_schema.label: FOV Degrees
params_schema.tooltip: Vertical field of view for perspective projection.

params_schema.label: Camera Distance
params_schema.tooltip: Distance from the mesh bounds center in the same units as the mesh.

params_schema.label: Yaw
params_schema.tooltip: Horizontal camera orientation in degrees.

params_schema.label: Pitch
params_schema.tooltip: Vertical camera orientation in degrees.

params_schema.label: Roll
params_schema.tooltip: Camera roll in degrees.

params_schema.label: Texture Max Size
params_schema.tooltip: Downsamples oversized source images before embedding them in the GLB.

params_schema.label: Unseen Regions
params_schema.tooltip: Records how surfaces outside the camera view should be handled downstream; unseen texture samples are always flagged.

nodes.name: UV Unwrap
nodes.description: Generates explicit seam-safe UV coordinates with a deterministic local parametrizer and exports a GLB derivative.

params_schema.label: UV Method
params_schema.tooltip: Selects the deterministic pymeshlab parametrization. Inspect island distortion before baking production textures.

nodes.name: Surface Map Bake
nodes.description: Bakes world-space normal and vertex-derived ambient-occlusion PNG sidecars onto a UV-enabled GLB derivative.

params_schema.label: Map Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Square resolution for the normal and ambient-occlusion sidecar images.

params_schema.label: UV Method
params_schema.tooltip: Parametrization used before map rasterization.

nodes.name: Geometry Integrity
nodes.description: Audits finite geometry, topology defects, boundaries, manifoldness, winding, and watertight volume without modifying the mesh.

params_schema.label: Require Watertight
params_schema.tooltip: Marks open boundaries for review when enabled; open meshes are allowed by default.

params_schema.label: Degenerate Area Epsilon
params_schema.tooltip: Triangle area at or below this value is counted as degenerate.

nodes.name: Visual Hull
nodes.description: Carves a voxel visual hull from two or three orthographic binary silhouette masks supplied as a JSON descriptor.

params_schema.label: Asset Name
params_schema.tooltip: Base name used for the generated mesh and report files.

nodes.name: BVH Build
nodes.description: Builds a deterministic triangle AABB hierarchy as a JSON sidecar for broad-phase queries and spatial inspection.

params_schema.label: Triangles / Leaf
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum triangle count stored in one leaf node.

params_schema.label: Max Depth
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum recursive depth of the generated hierarchy.

params_schema.label: Triangle Budget
params_schema.tooltip: Bounds sidecar size; an incomplete budget is marked needs_review.

nodes.name: Self-Intersection Audit
nodes.description: Detects triangle self-intersections in the world-space mesh and returns the source unchanged with a bounded face report.

params_schema.label: Max Reported Faces
params_schema.tooltip: Limits the face-index list while preserving the total intersection count.

nodes.name: Animation Audit
nodes.description: Inspects glTF/GLB skin bindings, joint counts, animation clips, channels, and morph targets without modifying the asset.

params_schema.label: Require Animation Clip
params_schema.tooltip: Marks a rigged mesh for review when it has no animation channels.

nodes.name: Morph Target Prep
nodes.description: Builds relative morph deltas from a base mesh and one or more world-space target vertex arrays.

params_schema.label: Movement Epsilon
params_schema.tooltip: Displacements at or below this value are stored as zero and counted as unmoved.
